title: Yori3o's Explosives
description: Adds Terraria-inspired explosives as weapon and useful tool.
body:
**Yori3o's Explosives** is a mod that adds a new mining tool to the game, as well as a weapon: throwable explosives.

## Features:

- Simple variations: grenade, bomb, and dynamite. They differ in blast radius and detonation time;
  
- Grenades do not break blocks, but only deal damage;

- Each variation has sticky version. It doesn't bounce off the surface, but sticks;

- Explosives can sometimes be found in underground structures;

- The sound of a lit fuse fading just before it explodes


<details>
<summary>🛠️ Configuration</summary>

You can adjust the explosion radius, damage, knockback, detonation time, block breaking, etc.

</details>
